# Skill Version

- Name: `sengo`

## Update Policy

- Increment patch for wording tweaks or example-only changes.
- Increment minor for support-surface additions (new supported command/operator/option).
- Increment major for breaking behavior changes in the skill's generation rules.

## Consumer Update Checklist

1. Replace your installed `SKILL.md` and `references/` content with the latest version.
2. Review this file for version changes.
3. Re-test representative prompts:
   - insert
   - find/findOne with sort/limit
   - updateOne with `$set`
   - index recommendations

## Compatibility Note

This skill version is aligned with the Sengo support docs in this repository as of the updated date above.
